desc:
🌊 Escape the flood with your car! 🚗

The water keeps rising. Floor it, climb the mountain and reach the top before the wave catches you.

How high can you get? 🏔️

How to play:
🚗 Drive up the mountain and escape the water
💰 Earn cash for every meter and grab the rings
🛁 40+ vehicles: from a bathtub on wheels to a rocket car
🗺️ 5 maps: Island, City, Jungle, Canyon and Volcano
⚡ Events every 10 minutes: storm, moon gravity, giant rings…
🔥 Train your nitro and use the turbo on the climb
🎁 Mystery boxes, spins, paints and trails
🏆 Beat the record for every car

👥 Join the TitanStudio group for +10% cash!
👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
